brief:
Themes to promote: R3-A (single-flight plus ownership token), R3-B (classify auth failures), R3-J (no read-modify-write before storage settles), R3-D (memoised parsed maps), R3-F (dateValue, Unicode split).

1. Sync and identity (R3-A/B/E). In app-1-2, single-flight trySyncEvents with `let syncRun=null, syncAgain=false`: if a run is in flight, set syncAgain and return syncRun, and when it finishes start at most one more. Register at most one pre-settle waiter, using a pending flag like saveInterestsPending. Make ensureAnonSession share one in-flight promise across callers. In app-1-10, mark synced the ids a chunk covered after each chunk succeeds (keep a parallel id array per chunk that includes the interleaved local-only rows). In app-1-4, sbAuth returns {ok,status,body}, and signup is allowed only after a refresh fails with 400/401 and error invalid_grant or refresh_token_not_found. On network/429/5xx return null and let the queue retry. In app-3-6, after the remote step succeeds, remove cp_sb_session first and on its own, record the remote success (a non-cp marker the sheet reads on retry), treat a refresh 400/401 after this module's own revocation as done, and use the neutral no-token copy from the finding.

2. Storage gate (R3-J). For app-1-1 use Option A: while storageWaiting(), the mutating actions (toggleStar, toggleShowStar, addToQueue/remove/move, recordHistory, rememberEpisode, cp_lastpick is L2's, cp_shard_shows) queue through afterStorageSettles and recompute from the settled store, painting optimistically from an in-memory overlay. Fall back to Option B (disable the controls with 'Loading your library…') only if A proves too wide. offerHomeOnboarding returns early while storageWaiting() and is offered again from afterStorageSettles. Add the boot-path test: a slow hydrate holding cp_saved={a}, toggleStar('b') before settle, and assert both a and b survive. For app-1-7, give each deal an epoch, and have its deferred recorder skip when a newer deal superseded it. Do NOT weaken durable-store property 2 (a write this session is never clobbered). The fix is to not write early, not to change hydration.

3. Size and parse cost (R3-D). In app-1-8, store storableEpisode(snap) in cp_saved, trim old entries on the next write, check lsSet's result, and leave the star off if the write was refused. Memoise savedMap/queueIds/storedEpisode parses keyed on the raw string from store.getItem. That same memo closes perf-3: EPISODE_NAVIGATION's getters then read cached maps, so player/client.js stays untouched. In app-1-12, cap _bufferedEvents at 500 once deferredScriptsRan is true and no event log was published.

4. Correctness. In app-1-6, resolve gen-<leaf> deterministically from the catalogue (the leaf exists and has at least GENERATED_PLAYLIST_MIN pool items), without the top-3 or slot-parent filters. In app-1-9, always apply the Up Next removal and then return if autoadvance is off, and add a test for the off switch. In app-1-13, `byRecency` uses dateValue. In app-1-14, split with /[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u and toLocaleUpperCase. For data-integrity-4, see founder Q1. The default is fail-closed: in Family Mode, hide an item unless explicit===false or its catalog.json show is rated clean. Route episodesForShow and the Library/show-page lists through the same predicate (poolFiltered's). Add a test/ invariant that fails if the predicate ever lets `explicit` undefined through. The 516-item data backfill is a separate data PR from the refresh pipeline's contentAdvisoryRating; do not hand-edit data/discover.json here.

5. Boot and settings. In app-3-13, wrap init's post-session body in try/catch. On failure, paint failedNoteHtml with Try again, still bind the drawer and hashchange, and call markFirstPagePainted in a finally. Add Array.isArray guards for cp_seen, cp_recent_branches and cp_history. In app-3-8, fix the copy and pin it and NARRATION_RATE in the listener-copy test. In app-3-10, clear auditioning only when it is still this id, and give refreshVoiceList a sequence guard. In app-3-11, add a voiceProbeRunning promise and disable #voice-probe-run until it settles.

6. Tests (R3-M). In tests-2, use node:test mock.timers for whenQuiet. In tests-11, set ceilingMs 150 and poll with a deadline. For tests-10, move the fake DOM into one shared test/helpers module that parses [name="value"], and land it FIRST so L2 (load-states, tests-3) can rebase onto it.

Keep diffs local, don't move functions, and make one commit per id so they cherry-pick. L4 edits the pin block and the generation-changed handler inside init's neighbourhood, so don't reformat that area. L6 adds learning_cursor to SB_USER_TABLES (one line, near clearStoredKeys), so merge around it.

brief:
Themes to promote: R3-K (every transport verb enforces its postcondition), R3-A (token check after every await in the manager), R3-B (AbortError is an expected cancel, an IDB close is transient), R3-C (IDB transactions have a deadline).

It also ports queue-state.js to Swift (PlayerQueueState.swift) with parity fixtures under player/parity. Rules: (a) before editing a function, `git show origin/engine/m1:<file>` and compare; if engine/m1 already changed or fixed it, say so in the PR and keep the edit mergeable onto both. (b) Guards go at existing lines: no moving, renaming or reformatting, one commit per id. (c) player-core-1 changes reducer behaviour in queue-state.js, so a parity row will change. Record the change in the PR for the engine owner so PlayerQueueState.swift is updated to match, and do not edit player/parity here. (d) Prefer the minimal-API fix everywhere: player-core-6 uses manager.play(currentIndex+1) the way forayPrevious already does, with no new skip API; player-core-9 drops a stale loadItem when state.target differs, and does NOT serialise _handle.

Transport (R3-K). player-core-1: skipToPrevious(null) from idle/ended is a no-op plus telemetry, and PlayerQueueManager.skipToPrevious passes refOf(this._currentItem()). Add a queue-state test and a client test for ‹‹ after a failed load. player-core-7: stop() pauses the element if it is still audible and always stops TTS when a synth line may be speaking. player-core-8: flushPositions() at the top of playForay. player-core-5: clear scrubbing on pointerup/pointercancel/blur/lostpointercapture, then render(). player-core-10: see founder Q5. The default is to delete the dead known-car-route branch and _knownCarRoutes and document that reconnecting never resumes; the native engine owns route policy.

Ownership (R3-A). player-core-2: capture a seq/state before `await backend.load(bridge)` and bail (stopping TTS for synth) unless still transitioning to this bridge. player-core-4: add a `_loadSeq !== seq` check straight after `await _speakNarration` and stop TTS on a supersede. player-core-9: as above.

Failure classes (R3-B/C). player-core-3: AbortError in play() is telemetry only; update html-audio-backend.test.js:2308-2315. player-rest-2: set db.onclose/onversionchange to reset dbPromise, and retry once on InvalidStateError in withStore; do the same in event-log.js (share the helper). player-rest-1: race withStore against a timeout of a few seconds (tx.abort, drop the db promise), bound each queued DurableStore op, make canKeep return false while a confined write for the key is in flight, and bound purge's await so a timeout reports 'unverified'. This is the HIGH item; its test must show a hung IDB op no longer blocks a vault write of cp_sb_session. player-rest-5: a click helper with .catch that logs to diag and calls render() in finally, and resets foray.pendingFrom when the awaited manager call throws. player-rest-4: DurableStore.keys(prefix) (or a cached _ownedKeys invalidated on set/remove) used by listProgress. Native TTS (R3-K/A/B). mobile-native-1 (HIGH): iOS speak() calls stopSpeaking(at:.immediate) when speaking or paused, and foray-tts.js web branch calls speechSynth.cancel() before speak. Add a queue-manager test that a skip from paused narration to narration tells the plugin to flush. mobile-native-2: speak() returns an utterance token (the Android UUID; an iOS UUID per utterance) that is echoed in 'finished'. Android ignores onDone for non-current ids, auditions carry a flag, and queue-manager stores the token and drops mismatched finishes (edit only _speakNarration/_onTtsFinished). mobile-native-3: implement both Android onError overloads to clear speaking/paused and emit finished with {error, utteranceId}, and have queue-manager skip at once. mobile-native-4: release with notifyOthersOnDeactivation on ->ended/none regardless of holding, and add the case to testSessionMoveTable. mobile-native-5: close the ORT session in finally and run the probe on its own executor/queue. mobile-native-6: cache only successes, with a 30-60 s retry-after on failure. mobile-native-7: set/remove treat a JSONException from read() as an empty store; get/keys still reject. mobile-native-8: overlap resolution (start asc, longest first, drop overlaps) and resume from plain text. mobile-native-10: AbortSignal.timeout on the DevTools fetch, with evaluate clamped to the remaining deadline.

brief:
Themes to promote: R3-L (the worker owns only its own paths and caches, and code and data come from one generation), R3-D (bounded caches, per-show feed cache, per-IP bucket), R3-C (timeouts and caps on the index proxy and id-map), R3-G (prototype-safe lookups in search), R3-F (Unicode fold in the topic tokenizer, UA import).

Service worker, first sub-PR, landing together with its tests. Order: tests-1 FIRST, because every later SW fix needs a harness that can fail. server.mjs serves sw.js with BUILD_ID replaced by computeManifest(files).deploy_id, and each 'new deploy' spec asserts a second worker appeared (installing/waiting, or redundant for the failure cases) and that foray-gen-<gen2> exists. app-3-14: seed a __manifest__ and assert that a tracked file keeps its verified bytes and an untracked one is written, await the recorded waitUntil promises instead of fixed ticks, and fix the fromOrigin comment. app-3-2: the fetch listener returns without respondWith for scope-relative api/. Better still, only put/serve manifest-tracked paths plus an explicit allowlist (data/show-index.tsv). On activate, purge api/ entries from the retained generation caches so existing listeners lose the trace; no app.js clearLocalData edit is needed. Add a test that a timed-out second query returns 504, not the first query's body. app-3-4: activate deletes only CACHE_PREFIX names plus a named legacy list; the test seeds foray-shows-index-v1 and someone-else and asserts both survive. app-3-7: bypass requests with a Range header or an audio/video destination. app-3-5 + perf-2 + app-3-3 are one design: a page's generation is decided once. stampPin rewrites the fallback HTML's script and modulepreload URLs with ?_fdid=<id>, and handleShell serves _fdid-tagged code from that generation (as handleData does). An untagged data fallback posts 'stale-shell' with {deployId} so the page pins itself and shows the reload bar. The build stamps <meta name="foray-deploy-id"> (next to BUILD_ID), and the generation-changed notice shows only when msg.deployId differs from it or a pin is set. These three touch app.js only in the pin block and the message handler.

Hosting. ci-release-15: validate --out, refuse ROOT or an ancestor or a dir containing .git, print usage and exit 2. security-11: drop docs/ux/foray-m3-prototype.html from EXTRAS. The Pages upload of `.` is in .github (L7 territory); note it for L7 rather than editing it. security-12: add a vercel.json headers rule with frame-ancestors 'none', nosniff and Referrer-Policy, pinned in test/vercel-headers.test.js.

API. Order: search-api-css-5 FIRST. Move appleBucket/searchCache/showIdMap/appleShowSearch into api/_lib (or _-prefixed), move api/test out of the function tree, and update api/package.json's test glob, the vercel-bundle test and the imports. Verify the Functions list in a PREVIEW deployment and paste it in the PR. Then search-api-css-3: api/_lib/feedCache.ts, a TtlCache<ParsedFeed> keyed by show_id (~5 min, LRU-capped) holding etag/last-modified for conditional revalidation, read by both api/episodes/search.ts and api/shows/[show_id]/episodes.ts. search-api-css-4: TtlCache maxEntries with oldest-first eviction plus an opportunistic expiry sweep, and a per-instance per-show fetch limit. security-10: a per-IP bucket (x-forwarded-for) in front of the shared Apple buckets, q between 2 and 200 chars, and stronger q normalisation. search-api-css-7: drop `immutable` (short max-age, or ?v=<release_tag>), add an AbortController of ~5 s, move arrayBuffer() inside the try, and use a byte cap plus gunzipSync maxOutputLength. search-api-css-8: ~2 s timeout, and after a failed release fetch cache the fallback with a retry-after of ~10 min. arch-drift-13: the DB branch paginates with the same cursor, emits next_cursor/degraded/error, and has connect() inside a try that degrades. Add a contract test that runs both branches through one shape assertion. arch-drift-14: import DEFAULT_FEED_USER_AGENT from backend and extend the politeness UA scan to api/. Supporting line for L2's app-1-5: apply the noguid fallback in mapLiveEpisode.

Search engine. search-api-css-2: Object.hasOwn (or Map/Object.create(null)) for mods, ALIASES and concepts, a defensive `typeof f?.type === 'string'`, and tests for constructor, constructor theory and hasownproperty. search-api-css-1: check concept membership before mods[tok], and when GENERIC_WORDS stripped the only content, treat the query as content (empty or thin), never as a pure filter. Add battery cases for deep learning, deep sea, speed of light and story, and re-run the full battery; this changes results. search-api-css-6: foldDiacritics inside tokenize, itemWordSet and scoreMatch, with accented cases. search-api-css-11: Date.parse plus Number.isFinite. search-api-css-10: delete the #pl-form/#pl-input, .cards4 and unused ui-v2 utility rules, keep #cr-form's half of the shared selector lists, rewrite the #cr-form comments, and re-run ui-tokens and the home IA test.

Pitfalls: api/ and vercel.json are UNLISTED in path-policy, so this lane's API/hosting PR needs a human merge. Keep it to one PR and keep sw.js/search-engine.js/styles.css in an auto-mergeable PR. The feed cache relies on parseFeed not throwing, which L6's backend-rest-1 fixes; either land after L6 or wrap parseFeed in a try in the handler. Per-instance caches do not survive cold starts, so don't claim a global rate.

Themes to promote: R3-E (ids minted once and carried: slot id, item id, Foray id, relay id), R3-B (transient retrieval failures are not memoised), R3-F (the publish gate uses the writer's findHoldingDoc), R3-H (the relay is local and authenticated).

Order. (1) One Anthropic call helper first (gen-10 + gen-14): meter, recordUsage on every create including re-asks, and assertNotTruncated on stop_reason 'max_tokens'. Route Continuity, DeepenAct, Spine, Verifier, PromptUnderstander and ExternalResearcher through it; parseWithRetry refuses repair on max_tokens. Check the current Messages API web-search block shapes (load the claude-api skill) before coding.

Identity (R3-E). gen-3 and gen-4 are one change: carry a stable slot id from slotsFromSpine through deepen, source, write and stitch, via an (actIndex, slotIndex) to id map passed to ForayStitcher/stitchAct and partialProjection. validateDeepenedAct restores or refuses retitled slots. Test that items carry the declared suffixed id. gen-6: a short guid hash suffix when the slug is truncated or collides, plus an assertion when newSegmentSources holds a different episode_guid. gen-7: fall back only to exact legacy names, open and verify the guid on any prefix match, and cache negative results. gen-13: checkpoint an `identity` stage {startedAt, forayId, topic, basis}. data-tools-1 + security-8 are one file (relay.mjs): per-process ids from crypto.randomUUID (or runStamp-seq), leftover queue/* moved to done/stale-<ts>/ at createRelay, header-derived ids sanitised, requests with an Origin header rejected, Host not 127.0.0.1/localhost:<port> rejected, and a per-run bearer token (printed at startup) required on /answer and /reset. Add a stale-reply test. The relay-answer Workflow (the answering session) must be updated to send the token in the same PR.

Failure classes (R3-B). gen-5: gather() returns retrievalFailed packs that PrefetchingEvidenceGatherer does not memoise and counts in `failed`; budget errors propagate. gen-12: return collisions and duplicate ids as checkForaysErrors (validation.ok=false), and drop the `source` checkpoint when a resumed run collides. gen-16: maxBuffer 64 MB, log res.error?.code and a stderr excerpt, and report 'phonemized N of M'.

Correctness. gen-2: keep [startSec,endSec] whole, shrink the padding symmetrically to fit, and mark any cut into the clip itself. gen-8: compute the Foray-wide first-clip-per-show set from sourced.acts before narration and pass each act the shows heard in EARLIER acts, then fix the doc. arch-drift-2: delete normalizeQuote; a non-tape quote is grounded iff findHoldingDoc(quote, page.evidence) is non-null. Add a curly-vs-straight apostrophe test. gen-11: replace the raw NUL with \u0000 (the CI control-char check is L7's call). gen-15: LRU on cuesByKey, an index build that doesn't populate it, root-keyed caches that honour FORAY_SKIP_CATALOGUE_CACHE, and runtimePool built from the injected segmentPool. gen-9: see founder Q4 and do not loosen the regexes without a ruling. The default is to add the four prompts as documented must-pass cases behind a skipped test with the ruling reference, and change nothing else.

Tooling. data-tools-8: take (code, signal) and set exitCode = code ?? (signal ? 128+n : 1). data-tools-12 + security-9: delete tools/events-server.mjs and scripts/events-server.vbs (and the path-policy DENIED entry, a one-line L7 edit to hand over), move the relay default port to 8788 and update its docs, and add a HUMAN-ACTION to remove ForayEventsServer.vbs from the workstation Startup folder.

Themes to promote: R3-H (RLS least-privilege per table; the hold label is atomic), R3-G (one never-throwing, range-checked, prototype-safe decoder), R3-J (partial runs merge; multi-step CLIs clean up), R3-E (the cursor keeps full precision), R3-A (budget check-and-record serialised).

Order: backend-rest-1 FIRST (L4's feed cache depends on parseFeed not throwing). decodeEntities decodes only 1..0x10FFFF excluding surrogates and otherwise returns U+FFFD or the raw match, and parseFeed wraps parseItem so one bad item becomes a warning. Add tests for &#99999999; and �. In the same edit: backend-rest-11 uses Object.hasOwn(NAMED_ENTITIES, entity); backend-rest-9 drops code point 0 and C0 controls except tab/LF/CR in decodeEntities/sanitizeHtmlToText, upserts in one statement inside BEGIN/COMMIT, and wraps ingestShowFeed in try/catch so it records last_fetch_ok=false and falls back to cached rows; backend-rest-10 normalises an empty guid to null, uses `||` in identity fallbacks, and avoids the positional idx.

RLS (R3-H). One new migration, e.g. backend/migrations/supabase/0003_rls_least_privilege.sql. For backend-rest-4: RLS on catalog_show_episodes and catalog_show_feed_state with select-only for anon/authenticated, and deny-all RLS on shows, episodes, episode_enrichment and cost_events. For backend-rest-5, split own_rows per table. CAREFUL: Delete my data (app.js SB_USER_TABLES) issues DELETEs, so events keeps insert+select+DELETE, and user_interests keeps select+DELETE (no insert/update: the service-role job is the only writer). taxonomy_nodes keeps select plus delete, with no client weight writes. events.ts is forced server-side (BEFORE INSERT trigger new.ts := now()). For data-integrity-10, add an own-rows DELETE policy for learning_cursor (or an FK cascade on app_users), add it to SB_USER_TABLES before app_users, and extend test/data-deletion.test.js to enumerate every table with a user_id column across ALL migrations. Before finalising, grep app.js for every PostgREST verb it uses per table, and add a test that pins policy verbs against client verbs. Applying this to production is founder Q3; the PR only adds the file.

Learning job. backend-rest-2: select ts as full-precision text (to_char ... US) and use it as the cursor, with a microsecond round-trip test. backend-rest-3: safeParseEventRow in fetchSince, skipping bad rows but advancing the cursor past them, per-user apply+cursor in one transaction, and a per-user try/catch in the CLI with exitCode=1. backend-rest-17: fire on streak % threshold === 0, with a running per-topic streak map. backend-rest-15: track the actual survivor. backend-rest-16: pass the raw date through so computeFreshness's neutral branch runs. backend-rest-13: serialise checkAndRecord with a promise-chain mutex and add a concurrent-calls test. backend-rest-12: backoff min(ttl, base*2^consecutive_failures). Do not edit the applied 0016 migration comment; record the politeness gap in docs instead, or delete the unused modules in a separate commit.

CLIs (R3-J). backend-rest-6: pass `--label hold` in `gh pr create` itself when args.hold is set, and exit non-zero loudly if the PR is not held. backend-rest-19: try/catch around commit/push/PR, reset and abandon the branch before a successful push, and print the branch plus a resume command after one. backend-rest-20: spawnSync timeout 10 min with SIGKILL, plus --test-timeout=120000. backend-rest-7: merge the existing report.json by prompt/basename and preserve publish/publish_refused. backend-rest-8: with --show, keep other shows' rows, and always rewrite on a full run. backend-rest-14: reuse fetchFeedConditional and refetch when the cache is older than N days or pending guids are missing. backend-rest-18: ACT_NUMBER uses firstLetterEitherCase, with Act Two/Three tests. backend-rest-22: \p{L}\p{N} plus \p{M} stripping in normalizeTitle.

Pitfalls: backend/src is DENIED, so this needs a founder merge; ship as two PRs at most (feeds+RLS, then curation+CLI). api/ consumes feeds/parser and catalog, so keep exported signatures. The RLS migration can break Delete my data if a verb is missed; the verb-pin test is mandatory. Never modify an already-applied migration.

Shared helpers first (R3-C/F/G). data-tools-7: route every feed and transcript body read (classify prepare-batch, sweep-transcripts fetchFeed + measure-suspects, backfill-show, fetch-transcripts) through fetch-limits readBodyCapped/fetchFeedCapped with the caller's AbortController and politeness headers.
